# MindCheck Tools

> Browser-based screening instruments, self-reflection tools, calculators, and guided exercises.
> Some pages implement published instruments; rights-limited instruments remain public as educational information without questionnaire administration or scoring. Other tools are educational or self-reflection resources. None provides a diagnosis or medical advice.

All interactive answers and scores are processed locally in the browser. Health-topic, instrument, result, crisis, privacy, and youth pages do not load optional analytics or advertising. Consented optional services are limited to the topic-neutral homepage. No account is required to use the tools.

## Editorial trust and scope

- MindCheck Tools publishes the site and is the named authoring organization.
- Health and substance-use content is reviewed for source alignment, scoring limits, and safety language by Jason Ramirez, Certified Alcohol and Drug Counselor Level II (CADC-II).
- CADC-II is a substance use counseling certification. It is not a physician, psychologist, psychiatrist, or independent mental-health license.
- [Reviewer profile and credential scope](https://mindchecktools.com/about/jason-ramirez)
- [Editorial methodology](https://mindchecktools.com/methodology)
- [Clinical evidence and source notes](https://mindchecktools.com/clinical-evidence)

## Published instruments: interactive and information pages

Interactive entries are educational self-screens, not diagnostic services. Entries labeled information contain no questionnaire, scoring, or personal result.
